name: openrig
description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
one_liner: Lets you set up a small team of AI coding assistants with defined roles that remember context and work together, handing you only the decisions that need a human.
buyer: A technical founder or engineering lead running a lean team who wants to multiply output by running several specialized AI 'employees' instead of one assistant at a time.
business_use_cases: A solo founder runs a build team of agents (one coding, one reviewing) overnight on a backlog of small features, reviewing only the finished, checked work in the morning.
A dev agency sets up a persistent 'client team' rig per repo so work and context never get lost between sessions or human team members.
An engineering manager runs a standing QA/review agent that checks every change from a coding agent before a human ever sees it.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid rig setup as a service for teams who want multi-agent workflows but don't want to configure YAML and tmux themselves.
Sell prebuilt rig templates (QA team, support triage team, content team) on a small marketplace.

steal_this: This weekend, build one polished two-agent template for a common task (feature-plus-reviewer) and sell it as a small download to other OpenRig users.
